posts.text:
To be truly pro-life is to protect both baby and mother throughout pregnancy, in the delivery room, and in the years that follow.

My latest op-ed on how I’m working in Congress on several initiatives to do just that.
posts.summary: Advocates pro-life protections for mothers and babies throughout pregnancy and beyond

posts.text:
I have urged the DOJ to protect women and unborn children by not only reinstating in-person requirements for mifepristone, but also to review the safety of these dangerous abortion drugs.

These drugs aren’t only taking the lives of unborn children, they’re putting women at risk, too.
posts.summary: Calls for in-person mifepristone requirements, warns of drug safety risks to women

posts.text:
I have sat across from too many Alabama parents and families who have lost children to fentanyl. One child lost is one too many.

On National Fentanyl Prevention and Awareness Day, we remember those we’ve lost and recommit to protecting our most precious asset, the next generation. Proud to have passed the HALT Fentanyl Act last year, and I will continue to fight for parents to have the information and tools they need to keep their children safe from fentanyl and deadly counterfeit pills.
